description:
List LLM request traces for your brand, newest first — filter by agent, model and status.
PAGES: `page` starts at 1 and `limit` is 1-100 (default 50). The answer carries `traces`, `total`,
`page` and `has_more`: ask for page + 1 while `has_more` is true. There is no offset.
`agent_id` is the agent's token UUID. `model` matches the requested or the served model name exactly.
name: gate_traces
